steps.description: Analyze current Profile and Preferences logic and plan unified currency selection integration.
steps.details: Review profile setup and settings to determine optimal way to add and save preferred currency, ensuring consistency and persistence via context/localStorage. Identify all areas where currency should be displayed (transactions, budgets, summaries, etc.) and plan updates.
steps.expected_changes: Clear understanding of how/where currency data is set, updated, and consumed for correct propagation and update.

steps.description: Add preferred currency select field to profile setup and update save logic.
steps.details: Expose a currency dropdown in the profile setup form (including onboarding/setup flow). On save, persist to localStorage and ensure this value updates currency preference in context/state if available.
steps.expected_changes: Profile setup form will always include (and validate/save) preferred currency.

steps.description: Add preferred currency selection to settings with two-way save.
steps.details: Show the same currency selector in settings; saving from either location updates the context/localStorage. Changing in either place instantly updates all money UI (via context).
steps.expected_changes: Settings/Preferences currency picker is unified with profile, and persisted on change.

steps.description: Update PreferencesProvider to sync with profile currency and emit symbol.
steps.details: Ensure that profile currency and context currency stay in sync (via a shared key in localStorage and context). Provide React context with both ISO code and symbol, and allow updates from either profile or settings.
steps.expected_changes: Currency symbol reflects the user's choice everywhere, and can be changed at any time.

steps.description: Refactor all transaction, budget, summary, and goal UIs to consume currency info only via context.
steps.details: Replace all hardcoded or local profile currency usages with consumption from PreferencesProvider context. Ensure transaction lists, budget planner, summaries, chart labels/legends, etc. use the context currency and symbol, and respond to user changes immediately.
steps.expected_changes: All UI displays current currency symbol and updates live.

assumptions: PreferencesProvider is the single source of truth for currency. Profile and settings both read and update it.
Currency choices will be a manageable set (e.g., USD, INR, EUR, GBP, CNY) for simplicity.
No backend sync, only localStorage/context required.
